$description: Global vocabulary — always applied regardless of client. Seed with people's names, company names, and any term you hear mangled across every meeting. Per-client vocabulary goes in resources/vocabulary/<client-id>.json or via the Settings UI.
notes: Add people's names (first-name-last-name pairs, not individual first names) and company proper nouns here as you notice mistranscriptions.

The 'requiresContext' field on a replacement (see the help panel in Settings -> Vocabulary) restricts that replacement to cases where at least one of the listed words appears in the same transcript. Useful for homophones.
